Dorf.description: Dorf ｢ドルフ, dorufu｣ is the Pegasus Knights' Commander and an executive of Gazel Dwargo. He spends most of his time in the public eye acting the role of a civil servant. A middle-aged man with light blonde hair, thick eyebrows, and a sharp nose. Dorf is an upright and honest man. He puts up a tough military facade when addressing others in his official capacity, but he is caring deep down. He tends to use Gazel as his mouthpiece to voice his concerns to Rimuru despite Gazel's complete trust in the slime. TBA
